Reduce the sparkle to about 36px."},{"element_id":"s10","problem":"Text is rendered slightly heavier and wider than the real text (bold headings, the 'Build, Share, Explore' title 1px too high). Use Roboto at weight 400 for body text and 500 for titles, and match the chip text sizes at 12px."}],"summary":"The mock is already close at about 9.4, with only 3 element misses.
